faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Rishikesh Consultant Psychiatrist OR Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for this recruitment drive is 18th August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by AIIMS Rishikesh?
faq.answer: AIIMS Rishikesh has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Consultant Psychiatrist OR Medical Officer in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant Psychiatrist post?
faq.answer: For the Consultant Psychiatrist position, candidates must possess an MD or DNB degree in Psychiatry from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Consultant Psychiatrist OR Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 110000 per month for this contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this recruitment is 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Rishikesh recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an examination followed by an interview to assess the suitability of the candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for contractual positions, meaning the selected candidates will be appointed on a contract basis.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, which will lead you to the relevant document.
